flows.caveat: Source/binding integrity is evidence of reviewed coverage, not proof of runtime semantics or every build profile.

limits: 2D fixed 640x480, one scanout, no mode setting or hotplug.
No mmap, 3D/VirGL, display terminal or keyboard/mouse driver.
Control requests use bounded 500 ms polling under a sleep lock.
Failed source copy may change backing prefix without submitting display transfer.
DMA pages retained if reset acknowledgement times out, to prevent late DMA into freed memory.
